tool_signatures.description: Drag from a source point to a target point (optionally relative to an element via

tool_signatures.name: find
tool_signatures.description: Locate elements or read page text without acting on them. Two modes: filter by

tool_signatures.name: get_element
tool_signatures.description: Get complete details for one element: exact position, size, state, and attributes. Requires an

tool_signatures.name: get_field
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed info about one form field (by

tool_signatures.name: get_form
tool_signatures.description: Analyze all forms on the page: fields, required inputs, validation rules, and field dependencies. Call this first on any multi-field or multi-step form to plan the fill order, instead of scrolling and screenshotting. Returns each form as XML with per-field eids, state, constraints, and the suggested next field to fill.

tool_signatures.name: go_back
tool_signatures.description: Go back one page in browser history. Returns a fresh page snapshot of the resulting page with its interactive elements.

tool_signatures.name: go_forward
tool_signatures.description: Go forward one page in browser history. Returns a fresh page snapshot of the resulting page with its interactive elements.

tool_signatures.name: hover
tool_signatures.description: Move mouse over an element without clicking. Triggers hover menus and tooltips.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_canvas
tool_signatures.description: Analyze a canvas element: auto-detect the rendering library, query its scene graph, and return an annotated screenshot with coordinate grid overlay.

tool_signatures.name: list_network_calls
tool_signatures.description: List HTTP requests and responses made by the page. Filter by resource type, method, status code, or URL pattern; supports pagination. Use after navigate or an action to inspect API traffic, confirm a request fired, or find failing calls (e.g. status_min=400). Returns request/response summaries as XML.

tool_signatures.name: list_pages
tool_signatures.description: List all open browser pages with their page_id, URL, and title.

tool_signatures.name: navigate
tool_signatures.description: Go to a URL. Returns page snapshot with interactive elements.

tool_signatures.name: ping
tool_signatures.description: Check if the server is responsive

tool_signatures.name: press
tool_signatures.description: Press a single keyboard key with optional modifiers, dispatched to the focused element. Use for submitting with Enter, dismissing with Escape, or keyboard navigation (Tab, arrows); use type to enter text. Returns a fresh page snapshot with any resulting changes.

tool_signatures.name: read_page
tool_signatures.description: Extract the main readable content from the page, removing navigation, ads, and clutter. Uses Mozilla Readability (Firefox Reader View engine). Best for articles, blog posts, documentation, and content-heavy pages.

tool_signatures.name: reload
tool_signatures.description: Refresh the current page. Use after a change that only takes effect on reload, or to recover from a stale page. Returns a fresh page snapshot with its interactive elements.

tool_signatures.name: screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page or a specific element. Use for visual verification or when layout/rendering matters; prefer snapshot or find for reading structure and text. Returns the image inline, or a file path when the image is large.

tool_signatures.name: scroll
tool_signatures.description: Scroll the viewport up or down by a pixel amount. Use to reveal more of a long page or trigger lazy-loaded content; use scroll_to when you know the target element. Returns a fresh page snapshot reflecting the new scroll position.

tool_signatures.name: scroll_to
tool_signatures.description: Scroll until a specific element (by

tool_signatures.name: search_network_calls
tool_signatures.description: Search network calls by URL pattern (substring or regex). Use when you know part of the endpoint URL and want just those calls, optionally with headers and request body; use list_network_calls to browse all traffic. Returns matching requests as XML with optional headers and body details.

tool_signatures.name: select
tool_signatures.description: Choose an option from a dropdown menu by value or visible text.

tool_signatures.name: snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Re-capture the page state without performing any action. Use when the page may have changed on its own (timers, live updates, animations).

tool_signatures.name: type
tool_signatures.description: Type text into an input field or text area (by

tool_signatures.name: wheel
tool_signatures.description: Dispatch a mouse wheel event at specific coordinates. Use for scroll-to-zoom (with Control modifier) or horizontal scrolling.
